title: Mask Adoption Dynamics
description: Simulate how individuals adopt and comply with mask-wearing over time under social influence, policy interventions, information campaigns, and supply constraints.

interactions.name: SocialInfluence
interactions.description: Individuals influence each other's mask adoption via their social network through observation and communication.

interactions.name: PolicyComplianceAtEntry
interactions.description: Locations enforce mask policies; individuals decide to comply, be denied entry, or incur penalties.

interactions.name: MaskPurchase
interactions.description: Individuals purchase masks from retailers subject to inventory and price.

interactions.name: CampaignExposure
interactions.description: Government and media broadcast messages affecting risk perception, norms, and trust.

interactions.name: SupplyReplenishment
interactions.description: Retailers replenish inventory based on replenishment rates and potentially demand signals.

interactions.name: RiskFeedback
interactions.description: Public health context updates risk alerts based on case trends, influencing personal risk perception and policies.

interactions.name: NormFormationWithinHousehold
interactions.description: Household members reinforce or weaken masking norms and share supplies.

metrics.name: adoption_rate_over_time
metrics.description: Proportion of individuals wearing masks at each time step.

metrics.name: peak_adoption
metrics.description: Maximum adoption rate observed during the simulation.

metrics.name: time_to_threshold_adoption
metrics.description: Number of days to reach a specified adoption threshold (e.g., 50% or 80%).

metrics.name: location_compliance_rate
metrics.description: Fraction of visitors compliant with mask policy at each location type.

metrics.name: stockout_rate
metrics.description: Percentage of time retailers have zero mask inventory.

metrics.name: campaign_effect_size
metrics.description: Change in adoption attributable to campaigns, e.g., difference-in-differences pre/post campaign.

metrics.name: inequality_in_adoption
metrics.description: Disparity in adoption across income or demographic groups (e.g., Gini coefficient).

metrics.name: policy_impact
metrics.description: Change in adoption or compliance associated with policy enactment or enforcement level.

validation_criteria.name: adoption_stability
validation_criteria.description: Adoption rate change below epsilon (e.g., <0.5 percentage points) for N consecutive days (e.g., 7 days) indicates convergence.

validation_criteria.name: inventory_non_negative
validation_criteria.description: Retailer inventory should never be negative; violations indicate modeling errors.

validation_criteria.name: rates_in_bounds
validation_criteria.description: All rates and probabilities must remain within [0,1].

validation_criteria.name: policy_effect_direction
validation_criteria.description: Stronger enforcement and higher penalties should not decrease compliance in aggregate unless countervailing parameters (e.g., reactance) are explicitly enabled.
